answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a bond in a shared harbor contract before trading, slashed if peers catch it faking work. Reputation then grows like a pearl, layer by layer, through verified completed jobs, so a fresh fake identity starts with zero trust and must spend real time and fees to gain standing. Registration can also demand a ferrous hardware attestation, a signed proof from a real device, making each identity cost a physical machine rather than a copied script.
